GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Dream
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: A direction for my dreams; or a trouble to recover from.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Dream
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Rest; reconsider your priorities; or risk yourself in exploration of the kingdoms of sleep.

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Study
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: The invisible arts could occupy ten lifetimes of study.

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Expenses
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: The shop-keepers will have their due. I must pay it or starve.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Time Passes
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Time, the sundial's shadow, passes. I must have Funds to live, or I will become ill.

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Work
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: Something I can do; something I know; or something I am.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Work
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Earn a living, or practice the invisible arts.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: A Trembling in the Air
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: The sun flickers like a shadow. Dreams ripple behind the surface of mirrors. I must be careful not to drift from the waking world. [Fascination may provoke Visions]
